kept.label: Export nutrition data
kept.what: Provide a JSON export of foods, recipes, logs, and cached daily stats for backup or downstream analysis.
kept.why: the technical brief explicitly calls for a data export module and JSON portability

kept.label: Pull recipe nutrition
kept.what: Fetch recipes and nutrition data from Mealie and cache them locally for offline logging.
kept.why: the ledger notes say FoodTracker pulls recipes and nutrition from Mealie's API

kept.label: Scan packaged foods
kept.what: Look up barcode-scanned foods against external nutrition databases during logging.
kept.why: the technical brief names Open Food Facts as primary and FoodData Central as an optional fallback

kept.label: LLM food capture
kept.what: Send a photo or text description to an LLM service to extract structured nutrition data for missing foods or recipes.
kept.why: the docs specify LLM extraction and recipe-builder services returning structured nutrition JSON
